requirement_results.evidence: No layout.json in the package (files present: checks/ (empty), design.json, llm/, measurements.txt, model.scad, model.stl, views/). design.json has no reference parts and no poses; model.scad contains only cube([90,70,4]) and a 90x4x4 strip, so no M-PICO2, M-HDR or M-JACK is placed anywhere. L3.1.1.1 FAIL (no file), L3.1.2.1/L3.1.3.1/L3.1.4.x/L3.1.5.1/L3.1.6.1 UNVERIFIED=FAIL. run.log: 'translate_L1.1: saturated after 30 iteration(s)'.

Measured model.stl (manifold3d): one shell, bbox [0,0,0]-[90,74,4], volume 26640 mm^3 = exactly its convex hull, so V-CAVITY volume = 0.0 mm^3 (no interior void). Seating rule (no standoffs, no cavity) puts the RBA centred over the plate with underside 4.0 above the top face: board frame origin at model (10,12,9.6). V-PICO (1194.2 mm^3) lies 100% outside the cavity -> L3.2.2.1 FAIL. L3.2.2.2 inner X length between end walls: no end walls exist -> FAIL. L3.2.1.2 'fits' (70x50x1.6 into BASE): no recess or pocket, top face Z=4 is a single plane -> FAIL. L3.2.1.1 clear_of(ALL, M-PERF, 0.5) = 4.0 mm passes only vacuously (the board floats in free air above a plate).

Vertex Z values are only {0, 4}; face normals are only the six box normals. There are 0 standoffs (need 4 at pitch 65.0 x 45.0 +/-0.25), no pilot holes (need d2.0-2.2, depth >= 5.0), no OD to measure. L3.3.1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4, L3.3.2.1/2.2, L3.3.3.1/3.2, L3.3.4.1 FAIL. L3.3.4.2 (base one shell) passes on the fused single body but the lid is fused into it (see L1.7).

No lid plate exists above the board: the highest material is Z=4.0, the board top (seated per rule) is Z=9.6, so the enclosure never closes over the board (L3.4.1.2 lid-underside proxy: no lid above the board -> FAIL). L3.4.3.1 inside(M-HDR u M-JACK, V-CAVITY, 0.3): cavity volume 0 -> FAIL. L3.4.2.2 standoff height: no standoffs -> FAIL. L3.4.1.1 (V-KO-TOP intersect body = 0.0 mm^3) and L3.4.2.1 (V-KO-BOT intersect = 0.0, min gap 0.0) pass only vacuously.

There is no -X end wall: the body's -X face is the 4 mm tall edge of a plate (X=0, Y 0-74, Z 0-4) with nothing above Z=4. No USB opening exists (V-AP-USB count = 0, need 1; L3.5.3.1 FAIL); L3.5.2.1 opening size UNVERIFIED=FAIL. L3.5.1.1 clear_of(ALL, V-USB-PLUG, 0.3) is unobstructed only because there is no enclosure. design.json claims a '20 mm x 10 mm USB port opening' that is not in the geometry (and 20x10 would exceed the 13.0 x 10.0 limit anyway).

No +X end wall (X=90 face is the 4 mm plate edge) and no jack openings: V-AP-AUX count = 0, need 2 (L3.6.3.1 FAIL); L3.6.2.1 UNVERIFIED=FAIL. design.json claims 'two 6.35 mm jack openings' that do not exist. L3.6.1.1 unobstructed only vacuously.

No separate lid: no lid.stl; in model.scad the 'lid' is linear_extrude of a 4x4 square, 90 long, at Y 70-74, Z 0-4, unioned with the base, giving one fused shell (decompose() = 1). L3.7.1.1 needs BASE 1 shell AND LID 1 shell -> FAIL; L3.7.1.2 no_overlap: the two are fused -> FAIL; L3.7.2.1/2.2 no lip; L3.7.3.x no bosses, no lid holes, no snaps or rails; L3.7.4.1 no seam -> all FAIL. Visible as the orange strip along the back edge in model_iso.png and model_top.png.

No walls at all: column probes on a 2 mm grid (1584 probes) give Z thickness 4.00 everywhere, i.e. a solid plate, not a shell. Side walls 2.0-4.0 (L3.8.2.1): none exist -> FAIL; lid plate (L3.8.2.3): none -> FAIL; L3.8.2.2 floor = 4.0 passes as a number but is a solid slab with nothing on top; L3.8.1.1 the 'enclosure' is open on 5 sides above Z=4 -> FAIL; L3.8.4.1 no wall-to-floor joints -> FAIL; L3.8.3.1 no openings -> UNVERIFIED=FAIL.

The single body passes its own printability checks (manifold NoError, 1 shell, 0 overhang faces, bed contact 100% of plan box, 90x74x4 <= 200). But the lid body does not exist, so L3.9.2.1 / L3.9.1.1 / L3.9.3.1 for the LID are UNVERIFIED = FAIL, and no print orientation is declared (no layout.json).

Assembly bbox 90.0 x 74.0 x 4.0: Y = 74.0 > 70.0 (margin -4.0 mm) -> L3.10.1.1 FAIL; the excess is the fused 'lid' strip at Y 70-74. X>Y holds. L3.10.2.1 stable passes (a flat slab), L3.10.4.1 underside flat passes, L3.10.3.1 tipping margin per port UNVERIFIED (there are no ports) = FAIL.

No standoffs, no screws, no lid -> L3.11.3.1 (lid and board fasteners separate) cannot be confirmed: FAIL. L3.11.1.1 (install path) and L3.11.2.1 (driver columns) are unobstructed only because there is nothing to install into.

Package gate G0 fails: base.stl, lid.stl, layout.json and the agent's interference report are all missing (checks/ is empty; design.json verification: verified=[], unchecked=['base','lid'], all_verified=false; outcome null). The package's own claims are false: the base description lists 'recessed floor, USB opening, two jack openings, four corner standoffs with pilot holes, four screw bosses' and the lid description 'sliding-fit over the base, 90 x 70 x 4' but the geometry is a plain 90x70x4 cube plus a 90x4x4 strip. run.log shows the run was killed at the 90-minute timeout.

summary: DOES NOT MEET (class WRONG; gates G0, G1, G3, G4, G5 fail). The delivered design is a single solid 90 x 74 x 4 mm slab: cube([90,70,4]) with a 90 x 4 x 4 'lid' strip fused along its back edge (Y 70-74). Measured with manifold3d: 1 shell, 12 triangles, volume 26640 mm^3 = its convex hull, so there is no cavity, no walls, no lid plate, no standoffs, no openings and no declared board layout; base.stl, lid.stl, layout.json and the self-report are missing, and the run was killed at the 90-min timeout with L1.1 translation saturated. All 12 L1s fail. The only checks that pass (flat slab printability, stability, and clear_of checks against plug, keep-out and install envelopes) pass vacuously because there is no enclosure to obstruct them. Weighted score is effectively 0 for meaningful checks; the worst weight-3 margin is unbounded (V-PICO 100% outside a zero-volume cavity; 0 of 4 standoffs). Observations: (1) benchmarks/enclosure/parts/ is empty, so the parts catalogue the requirements reference does not exist yet; I built reference volumes from requirements.md section 2.2 numbers. (2) The claude-context MCP server failed to connect in this session; no code search was needed, only reads of known paths (plus one grep inside requirements.md for headings).
